source.title: Choose where your dates come from
source.body: Every downstream step reads from your dates: casting breakdown, priorities and who can be asked. Pick the source that fits how your team already works.
points: Airtable sync brings productions and dates in automatically, hourly.
Adding by hand works too, and you can mix both.
You can change your mind later without losing anything.

connect.title: Connect Airtable
connect.body: Link your Airtable base so ShowFlow can read your productions and dates directly, with no manual copying.
points: Paste your Airtable token to grant read access.
Pick the base and table that hold your dates.
ShowFlow checks the connection before you continue.
connect.article: Read more about the Airtable connection

map.title: Map your fields
map.body: Match each Airtable column to the ShowFlow field it represents, so every date arrives with the right production, date and city.
points: Required fields must be mapped before sync can run.
Optional fields can be mapped now or skipped for later.
You can revisit this mapping any time in Settings.

cities.title: Set a city on every date
cities.body: The booking engine only offers a date once it knows which city it is in. A date with no city sits idle.
points: Fix a missing city directly from the Dates list.
Cast ranking is set per city, so this comes before ranking.
New dates synced from Airtable inherit their city automatically.

productions.title: Review your productions
productions.body: Your productions are the work you book artists against. Check the ones that came in and add any that are missing.
points: Each production needs its casting breakdown set.
You can edit a production's details at any time.
New dates attach to an existing production or a new one.

artists.title: Add your artists
artists.body: Nobody can be booked until your roster has active artists. Add them by hand or import a sheet.
points: Artists get no email until you ask them about a date.
Importing a sheet is faster for a large roster.
You can add more artists at any time.

skills.title: Set skills on your artists
skills.body: Skills tell the booking engine which artists match which part in the casting breakdown.
points: A part with no matching skill has nobody eligible.
You can set skills for several artists at once.
Skills can be edited later without affecting past bookings.

coverage.title: Rank your casts
coverage.body: Cast priorities decide who is asked first in each city. A city with no first group opens to nobody.
points: Rank at least one group per city with a date.
A production's own cast beats the city ranking.
Ranking is per city, not per production.

flow.title: Set your booking flow
flow.body: Asks go out in groups. The first group is asked first, and later groups open only if a group falls short.
points: Decide how many groups you want, and in what order.
A change here is logged for later reference.
This applies from the next daily send onward.

timing.title: Confirm the ask timing
timing.body: This sets when asks go out and how long an artist has to answer before the ask expires.
points: The daily send happens at the hour you choose.
A longer answer window means a slower fill.
This applies to tonight's daily send.

team.title: Invite your production team
team.body: The producers who plan dates, run asks and book the cast. Booking can stay with you if you prefer.
points: Invited producers get an email invite.
You can remove a producer's access at any time.
Producers see only the dates in their org.

letterhead.title: Set your letterhead
letterhead.body: Your name, address and logo appear on every contract you issue.
points: Used on every contract, no exceptions.
Update it any time from Settings.
A missing letterhead blocks issuing.

fee.title: Set your default fee
fee.body: The fee that appears on a new contract by default, before any adjustment for a specific booking.
points: Saves time on every contract you draft.
You can still adjust the fee per contract.
Changing this default does not touch issued contracts.

terms.title: Write your terms
terms.body: ShowFlow ships no default clauses. The terms you write here go out on every contract.
points: Write your own clauses, or paste in an existing template.
You can keep more than one terms variant.
A missing terms set blocks issuing.

document.title: Style your contract document
document.body: Choose the layout and styling that goes out on every contract you issue.
points: Preview the document before you issue anything.
Styling applies to every future contract.
Past contracts keep the styling they were issued with.
document.article: Read more about the contract document

countersign.title: Set your countersignature
countersign.body: Decide who signs on behalf of the org on every issued contract.
points: A missing countersignature blocks issuing.
You can change the signer at any time.
The signature appears on every contract from here on.
